info.name: ELearning API integration tests
info.description: End-to-end smoke tests replayed by newman in CI (MAIR-117). `baseUrl` is injected by docker-compose-integration.yml; the default in environment.json targets a local stack. JWTs are forged in the collection pre-request script with the stack's JWT_SECRET for the seeded Admin (user 1) and a plain agent (user 2). The API has no route to create courses: init-test.sql (seeder service) provides course 1000 with modules 1001/1002 and attachment 1003, and resets user 2's progress. The scenario browses the catalogue as admin, registers the agent, walks the agent through the modules and the attachment URL, checks the admin progress views, then unregisters the agent.
